query:
SELECT 
  p1.id, p2.id as id2,
  p1.cardId, p1.jpyPrice, p1.grade, p1.sourcePosition,
  p1.soldAt as soldAt1, p2.soldAt as soldAt2,
  ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) as hour_diff
FROM priceHistory p1
JOIN priceHistory p2 ON (
  p1.id < p2.id
  AND p1.cardId = p2.cardId
  AND p1.source = 'snkrdunk'
  AND p2.source = 'snkrdunk'
  AND p1.jpyPrice = p2.jpyPrice
  AND COALESCE(p1.grade, '') = COALESCE(p2.grade, '')
  AND p1.sourcePosition = p2.sourcePosition
  AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.soldAt, p2.soldAt)) <= 72
)
GROUP BY p1.cardId, p1.jpyPrice, p1.grade, p1.sourcePosition
LIMIT 10;
